const int MAXN = 505;

int n, m, MOD;

inline int normalize(int x) {
    if (x < 0) return x + MOD;
    if (x >= MOD) return x - MOD;
    return x;
}

inline void add(int &x, int y) {
    x = normalize(x + y);
}

long long mod_pow(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) res = res * base % MOD;
        base = base * base % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int fact[MAXN], inv_fact[MAXN];

void precompute(int max_n) {
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= max_n; ++i)
        fact[i] = 1LL * fact[i-1] * i % MOD;
    inv_fact[max_n] = mod_pow(fact[max_n], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = max_n - 1; i >= 0; --i)
        inv_fact[i] = 1LL * inv_fact[i+1] * (i+1) % MOD;
}

int comb(int n, int k) {
    if (n < 0 || k < 0 || n < k) return 0;
    return 1LL * fact[n] * inv_fact[n-k] % MOD * inv_fact[k] % MOD;
}

vector<int> operator*(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
    vector<int> c(a.size() + b.size() - 1, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)b.size(); ++j)
            add(c[i+j], 1LL * a[i] * b[j] % MOD);
    return c;
}

int triangular(int x) {
    return x * (x + 1) / 2;
}

int G(int n, int m) {
    return comb(m + n - 1, n - 1);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> m >> n >> MOD;
    precompute(m << 1);
    
    vector<int> f(n + 1), g(n + 1);

            add(f[i], 1LL * f[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % MOD * comb(i - 1, j) % MOD);
        }
        f[i] = 1LL * f[i] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            long long term1 = 2LL * f[j] * g[i - 1 - j] % MOD * comb(i - 1, j) % MOD * (i + 1) % MOD;
            long long term2 = 1LL * comb(i - 1, j) * (triangular(j) + triangular(i - 1 - j)) % MOD * f[j] % MOD * f[i - 1 - j] % MOD;
            add(g[i], (term1 + term2) % MOD);
        }
    }
    
    f[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        g[i] = 1LL * g[i] * inv_fact[i] % MOD;

    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m - n + 1; ++i) {

    cout << ans << '\n';
